title: Fix Billing Race Condition and Implement Enrollment Grace Period
description: MicroCampus Nexus, a growing online learning platform, is facing a critical production bug. The finance department reports that a number of students are being incorrectly charged for courses they dropped just before the add/drop deadline. The suspected root cause is a race condition between the `enrollment_service` (which handles course withdrawals) and the `billing_service` (which processes payments based on enrollment snapshots). This task requires diagnosing the issue, implementing a robust fix, and then enhancing the system with a new user-friendly billing feature over multiple development sessions.

project_spec.name: MicroCampus Nexus
project_spec.description:
MicroCampus Nexus is a high-performance, C-based education platform designed for universities and online learning consortia that need consumer-grade social features without sacrificing academic workflows. The system decomposes the traditional learning management system into task-oriented microservices—Enrollment, Assessment, Content Delivery, Collaboration, Billing, and Notification—each communicating through lightweight REST and gRPC endpoints. Students can create study circles, follow courses, upload assignments, and purchase premium tutoring hours; instructors can manage syllabi, grade submissions, and receive analytics in real time. 

Built for heavy concurrent usage, the platform leverages C’s speed and deterministic memory footprint to serve everything from video lectures to discussion feeds. Every service embeds strong user authentication, role-based authorization, caching, and observability hooks. Social logins (Google, Facebook, GitHub) sit beside campus SSO to minimize onboarding friction, while responsive web components ensure that learners using low-powered devices receive an optimized UI. The design purposefully separates academic data flows (marks, rubrics, accreditation records) from social streams (likes, follows, comments) so institutions can comply with FERPA/GDPR yet still foster community engagement.
dependencies: libmicrohttpd (lightweight HTTP/1.1 server for REST endpoints)
OpenSSL / LibreSSL (TLS, JWT signing, password hashing via PBKDF2)
libpq (PostgreSQL client) + SQLC-Generator for Repository pattern
SQLite for edge caching in the Content Delivery service
librabbitmq-c (AMQP message broker for email & notification queues)
libcurl (outbound HTTP calls to payment gateways and social OAuth providers)
libmagic & libzip (secure file-type detection and compressed upload processing)
CivetWeb or FCGI-C for optional embedded web server in Admin UI
Docker & Kubernetes manifests (container orchestration for each microservice)
Prometheus C client + Grafana dashboards (metrics & alerting)
